buyingTickets_receipt_name: Can I get a receipt for my booking?
buyingTickets_receipt_response: You can download your receipt by going to 'My orders' in the account management section of our website and click the 'receipt' link for the specific order.
buyingTickets_giveTicket_name: Can I give my ticket to someone else?
buyingTickets_noEmail_name: What can I do if I didn't receive an email confirmation?
buyingTickets_noEmail_response: Sign in and click the account name on the top right bar. Go to my purchases. If you can see the purchase, the transaction was successful. Check the email in your account and make sure it is correct. Also, be sure to check your Junk or Spam folders. If the purchase isn’t visible, the purchase wasn't completed. Please contact our customer care team to assist you.
receivingTickets_changeAddress_name: Is it possible to change my delivery address?
receivingTickets_changeAddress_response: Once your tickets are shipped, you will need to contact the shipper (i.e. UPS) to adjust delivery. If your tickets have not been shipped, you can change the delivery address in your account details by signing in and clicking the name of the account in the top right bar.
receivingTickets_downloadEtickets_name: How can I download my e-tickets?
receivingTickets_downloadEtickets_respon: You can check the status of the tickets in your account details. If the status is 'Sent' and you haven't received an email, you can download them directly from the website.
receivingTickets_pickup_name: Can I pick up tickets in person?
receivingTickets_pickup_response: Gigsberg is a global marketplace and the sellers are private individuals from around the world, thus delivery service is the most reliable method, at this time.
payments_methods_name: Which payment methods are available on your website?
payments_methods_response: Currently, we support all types of debit/credit cards, Apple pay, Goggle Pay, Volt
payments_doubleCharged_name: What should I do if I was double-charged?
payments_doubleCharged_response: Please contact our customer care service and they will be happy to assist you.
payments_refund_name: When will I receive my refund?
payments_refund_response: Typically refunds can take up to 28 business days. If more than 28 business days have passed, please contact our customer care team and they will be happy to assist you.
cancellation_covid_name: If an event has been postponed or rescheduled due to COVID-19 (coronavirus)
cancellation_covid_response: You do not have to do anything. Your tickets are valid for the postponed event. All events are considered valid unless there has been an official announcement stating the event has been cancelled.
cancellation_refundEvent_name: Will I get a refund because of a cancelled event?
cancellation_refundEvent_response: Yes, if an event is cancelled or there is a substantial change (including the venue or city), you will receive an email with all available options, including a full refund.
cancellation_eventCancelled_name: What happens if the event is cancelled?
cancellation_eventCancelled_response: If an event was cancelled, you will be fully reimbursed.
cancellation_changeTickets_name: Can I cancel or change tickets?
cancellation_changeTickets_response: Gigsberg is a marketplace, all sales are final, thus, no changes or cancellations can be made. We do, however, offer you the opportunity to list your tickets for the majority of events for resale on our platform.
cancellation_noRefundYet_name: I didn't receive my refund yet. What should I do?
cancellation_noRefundYet_response: Typically refunds take up to 14 days. If that time has passed, please contact our customer care team and they will be happy to assist you.
sellingTickets_resellBought_name: Is it possible to resell tickets I bought on Gigsberg?
sellingTickets_resellBought_response: Yes, Gigsberg is happy to offer the opportunity for you to resell your ticket by clicking on the Sell Tickets link on our website, in the top right corner of the page.
sellingTickets_resellAbroad_name: Can I resell tickets if I live in another country?
sellingTickets_resellAbroad_response: Sure. You can resell your tickets and use our UPS service for delivery.
sellingTickets_paymentWhen_name: When will I get paid for the tickets?
sellingTickets_paymentWhen_response: You will receive payment 28 days after the event.
sellingTickets_creditCardWhy_name: Why do I need to provide my credit card number, I'm the seller?
sellingTickets_creditCardWhy_response: Gigsberg requests your Credit Card information for security reasons. If you are unable to provide the tickets you offered, Gigsberg will fulfill the order and you will be charged for the cost.
sellingTickets_paymentMethod_name: How can I get paid when selling tickets on Gigsberg?
sellingTickets_paymentMethod_response: We pay sellers using a bank transfer.
websiteSupport_createAccount_name: How do I create an account on your website?
websiteSupport_createAccount_response: On the top bar of Gigsberg's website, you will see a sign up link. Click the link and follow the instructions provided.
websiteSupport_forgotPassword_name: I forgot my password, what should I do?
websiteSupport_forgotPassword_response: Choose the 'Sign In' option and click on 'Forgot Password' link. Enter your email address and a reset password email will be sent immediately.
websiteSupport_noResetEmail_name: Why I am not getting my reset password email?
websiteSupport_noResetEmail_response: Please check your spam or junk email folder. If you are using Facebook Connect, bear in mind that the email is sent to the email address updated in your Facebook account settings. If nothing helps, contact our customer service team - we will be happy to assist you.
websiteSupport_changeAccountInfo_name: Can I change the information on my account?
websiteSupport_changeAccountInfo_respons: Yes. Sign in to your account, and you will see your account name in the top right bar. Click your account name to open the account management console. Once there, you can manage all the settings.
customerSupport_whenContact_name: When can I contact Customer Support?
customerSupport_whenContact_response: Our customer support team is available 7am - 1am 7 days a week, and can be contacted by email and different messaging applications. All contact information can be found at the following link: https://www.gigsberg.com/contact-us
customerSupport_howContact_name: How can I contact customer service?
customerSupport_howContact_response: You can find all contact information for reaching our customer support team at: https://www.gigsberg.com/contact-us
customerSupport_bookByPhone_name: Can I book tickets by calling to customer support?
customerSupport_bookByPhone_response: At this time, all orders can be placed online, only.

Gigsberg services are available 24/7 on any platform. We provide high quality customer support by an experienced team available 16 hours a day, 7 days via email, web or chat.

responsibility-description1: Gigsberg employees and managers feel it’s important to give back to the community. As we are a company dealing with experiences, we thought we should find a cause that helps people better enjoy life and sports. Our first partnership is with the Special Olympics, and our wish is that many will follow. Special Olympics is an everyday, everywhere movement changing the world for people with and without intellectual disabilities. For 50 years, Special Olympics has been building a movement to break down barriers – both on and off the field in health and education – all through the power of sport. Their Purpose –
responsibility-description2: END DISCRIMINATION AGAINST INDIVIDUALS WITH INTELLECTUAL DISABILITIES
responsibility-description3: Special Olympics showcases the strengths of our athletes and delivers life-changing interventions that breakdown institutional, cultural and personal stigmas.

faq_header_description: Answers about buying, receiving and selling tickets — every order backed by our Buyer Guarantee.
faq_no_results: No answers match that search. Try different words, or reach our team below.
aboutGigsberg_1_response: Because you get access to tickets for thousands of live events — including sold-out and high-demand shows — with every order backed by our <termsAndConditions>guarantee</termsAndConditions>, a secure checkout that shows your full price before you pay, and friendly support on hand. Booking with us is simple, safe and reassuring.
aboutGigsberg_2_response: Gigsberg is a secure marketplace for live-event tickets. We bring together listings from trusted sellers and handle your order safely from start to finish — all backed by our <termsAndConditions>guarantee</termsAndConditions>.
aboutGigsberg_3_name: Are my tickets valid and guaranteed?
aboutGigsberg_3_response: Yes — every ticket you order through Gigsberg is valid and backed by our <termsAndConditions>Buyer Guarantee</termsAndConditions>. In the rare event something isn't right, we'll put it right for you.
gettingYourTickets_1_name: When will I receive my tickets after purchasing?
gettingYourTickets_1_response: Usually in the weeks or days leading up to the event — the event’s primary distributor often releases tickets close to the date. Rest assured your order is <termsAndConditions>guaranteed</termsAndConditions>, and you’ll have your tickets in time to attend.
gettingYourTickets_2_name: Is it normal that I only receive my tickets a few days before the event?
gettingYourTickets_2_response: Yes — it's completely normal. Tickets often arrive in the final days before the event, and occasionally on the day itself if the official distributor releases them late. Either way, your order is <termsAndConditions>guaranteed</termsAndConditions> and — as long as your delivery details are correct and you follow the instructions we send — you'll have your tickets in time to attend.
gettingYourTickets_3_name: My event is close and I still haven't received my tickets — what should I do?
gettingYourTickets_3_response: Tickets are sometimes released close to the event, so this doesn't necessarily mean there's a problem. First, sign in and check “My Purchases”, your Spam folder and any delivery instructions we've sent. If your event is within 48 hours and your tickets still aren't available, message us on <liveChat>LiveChat</liveChat> or <whatsapp>WhatsApp</whatsapp> with your order number — we'll check your order and help you before the event.
gettingYourTickets_4_name: How will my tickets reach me?
gettingYourTickets_4_response: Once your order's confirmed, we'll let you know how your tickets will be delivered — the method is set by the event's official distributor. It may be e-tickets to download, mobile tickets (added to your phone or opened in the official app), or paper tickets by courier. We'll send simple instructions as soon as your tickets are ready.
gettingYourTickets_5_name: I didn't get a confirmation email — what now?
gettingYourTickets_5_response: No need to worry. Sign in and check “My Purchases” — if your order's there, you're all set (do check your Spam folder for the email). If it isn't showing, the order didn't complete; just <whatsapp>contact us</whatsapp> and we'll help.
gettingYourTickets_6_name: My mobile tickets aren't showing up — what should I do?
gettingYourTickets_6_response: First, make sure you're using the same email or phone number as your order, opened in the official ticketing app. Still not showing? Message us on <liveChat>LiveChat</liveChat> or <whatsapp>WhatsApp</whatsapp> and we'll sort it out before the event.
gettingYourTickets_7_name: Do I need to bring my confirmation email to get in?
gettingYourTickets_7_response: No — your confirmation is just your receipt. You get in with the tickets themselves (e-ticket, mobile ticket or paper ticket). Keep the confirmation handy just in case, but it's the tickets you'll show at the door.
gettingYourTickets_8_name: What if there's a problem with my ticket?
gettingYourTickets_8_response: In the rare event that your tickets are denied or found to be invalid at the venue, please request official proof of denial from the venue and <whatsapp>contact us</whatsapp> immediately. While you are still at the venue, our Customer Support team may be able to investigate and assist you in real time. If the event has already concluded, you may submit the official proof to our Compliance Department for further review.
gettingYourTickets_9_response: For most events, tickets are released in the days or weeks leading up to the date, so if they're not available yet, that's completely normal. To check your order, sign in and open “My Purchases”, and follow any delivery instructions we've sent — and do check your Spam folder for our emails. Your order is <termsAndConditions>guaranteed</termsAndConditions>, so you'll have your tickets in time to attend. If your event is very close and they still aren't showing, just contact us and we'll help.
choosingYourTickets_1_name: Will my seats be together, and what does “restricted view” mean?
choosingYourTickets_1_response: Seats in the same order are placed together where possible; for larger orders, we can only ensure up to two seats side by side. A listing marked 'restricted' or 'obstructed view' means a fixed feature of the venue — such as a pillar or barrier — blocks part of the view from that seat. This applies only where the listing carries that label, so please check the listing notes before you order.
choosingYourTickets_2_name: Can I buy a single ticket, or do I have to buy the whole set?
choosingYourTickets_2_response: It depends on the listing — tickets are often sold in sets, and some can't be split so a lone seat isn't left behind. The available quantities are shown as you choose, so you can pick what fits your group.
choosingYourTickets_3_name: Do my tickets need to be in my name?
choosingYourTickets_3_response: Usually not — most events don't need a name on the ticket. For ID or named-ticket events, you'll add each attendee's name at checkout. Please enter them carefully and follow the instructions we send: the organiser needs them for entry, and orders where the required names are missing or incorrect can't be refunded under our <termsAndConditions>guarantee</termsAndConditions>.
choosingYourTickets_4_name: Can I give my tickets to someone else?
choosingYourTickets_4_response: In most cases, yes — if you can't go, you're welcome to pass your tickets on. The exception is ID or named-ticket events, where entry is tied to the name on record. Not sure? Just <whatsapp>ask us</whatsapp> and we'll check for you.
pricesAndPayment_1_name: Why is the price different from the face value?
pricesAndPayment_1_response: Gigsberg is a secondary marketplace, so prices are set by the sellers and can sit above or below face value, especially for popular events. Whatever the price, the full price is always shown before you pay.
pricesAndPayment_2_name: Which currency will I be charged in?
pricesAndPayment_2_response: You're charged in the currency shown on the Gigsberg site you're using. If your card is in another currency, your bank may apply its own exchange rate — that part's set by your bank, not us.
pricesAndPayment_3_name: Which payment methods do you support?
pricesAndPayment_3_response: Credit and debit cards by default, plus options like bank transfer, Apple Pay, Google Pay or PayPal where available. You'll see every option offered at checkout.
pricesAndPayment_4_name: How do I know my payment went through?
pricesAndPayment_4_response: Once your provider confirms it, you'll get an order confirmation email from us. Any doubts? <whatsapp>Contact our team</whatsapp> and we'll check your order status right away.
changesCancellationsRefunds_1_name: Can I change or cancel my order?
changesCancellationsRefunds_1_response: As tickets are listed by individual sellers, orders are final once confirmed. The exceptions are if your tickets can't be delivered in time, the event is officially cancelled and not rescheduled, or you're refused entry with an invalid ticket (with proof) — and in those cases we'll make it right under our <termsAndConditions>guarantee</termsAndConditions>, as set out in our <termsAndConditions>Terms & Conditions</termsAndConditions>.
changesCancellationsRefunds_2_name: Can I exchange my tickets for a different date or event?
changesCancellationsRefunds_2_response: Not once your order's confirmed — we can't swap dates, events or quantities. If your plans change, the easiest option is to list your tickets for sale on Gigsberg so they don't go to waste.
changesCancellationsRefunds_3_name: My event was cancelled — will I be refunded?
changesCancellationsRefunds_3_response: If it's officially cancelled and not rescheduled, we'll get in touch about your refund. For paper tickets, you'll need to return them to us first; digital tickets don't need returning. Full details are in our <termsAndConditions>Terms & Conditions</termsAndConditions>.
changesCancellationsRefunds_4_name: My event was moved to a new date — can I still get a refund?
changesCancellationsRefunds_4_response: When an event is postponed or rescheduled, your tickets stay valid for the new date, so a refund isn't available. Refunds apply only to events that are officially cancelled, as confirmed by the organiser.
changesCancellationsRefunds_5_name: How long will my refund take?
changesCancellationsRefunds_5_response: Once a refund is approved, we'll process it as quickly as we can. If you've been waiting longer than expected, just <whatsapp>contact us</whatsapp> and we'll chase it up for you.
sellingTickets_1_name: I can no longer attend — what are my options?
sellingTickets_1_response: No problem — you can list your tickets for sale on Gigsberg, so you can recoup your outlay and the tickets don't go to waste.
sellingTickets_2_name: Can I resell tickets I haven't received yet?
sellingTickets_2_response: Yes — once your order is confirmed, you can list your tickets for sale even before they've reached you, as long as they were originally ordered through Gigsberg.
sellingTickets_3_name: Will my tickets go live for sale?
sellingTickets_3_response: Usually — though it's not <termsAndConditions>guaranteed</termsAndConditions>. Approval depends on the event and meeting our listing requirements, and we can't promise a listing will appear at a particular time or position.
sellingTickets_4_name: When and how do I get paid for tickets I sell?
sellingTickets_4_response: Once your tickets have sold and the event's taken place, you're paid within 14 business days (as long as the buyer reports no issues). Our service fee is deducted, and the balance goes by international bank transfer to the account in your “Payment account” settings.
yourAccount_1_name: How do I set up an account?
yourAccount_1_response: You can create one at checkout, or beforehand via “Create account” in the Log In / Create Account section — just add your email and a password.
yourAccount_2_name: I forgot my password — how do I reset it?
yourAccount_2_response: Click “Sign In”, then “Forgot Password”, enter your email, and we'll send a reset link straight away.
yourAccount_3_name: My password-reset email isn't arriving — what should I do?
yourAccount_3_response: Check your Spam or Junk folder first. Still stuck? <whatsapp>Contact our team</whatsapp> and we'll get you back in.
yourAccount_4_name: Can I update my account details?
yourAccount_4_response: Yes — sign in, open your account menu (top right), and you can update your settings there.
contactUs_1_name: How and when can I reach your team?
contactUs_1_response: We're here to help. Message us on <liveChat>LiveChat</liveChat> or <whatsapp>WhatsApp</whatsapp> for the fastest reply, or email <supportEmail>support@gigsberg.com</supportEmail> for general help and <sellingEmail>selling@gigsberg.com</sellingEmail> for selling. We're available 24/7 and always happy to help.
faq_footnote_subtitle: Our team is here to help with anything the answers above don't cover.
